items.name: Anywhere City
items.summary: Dystopian city of 2013 split into three districts by bridges and water.

items.name: Downtown
items.summary: Corporate skyscrapers, the Zaibatsu tower and Yakuza turf.

items.name: Industrial
items.summary: Docks, factories and the Rednecks.

items.name: Residential
items.summary: Suburban and asylum district, home to the Loonies.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto III
games.notes: First 3D entry. Three islands unlocked by story progress; Claude never speaks.

items.name: 8-Ball
items.summary: Frees Claude from the police convoy at the start of the game and runs a bomb shop in Portland.

items.name: Asuka Kasen
items.summary: Runs the Yakuza's Staunton Island operations and becomes Claude's main employer after Portland.

items.name: Catalina
items.summary: Claude's ex-girlfriend who shoots him at the start and later leads the Cartel.

items.name: Claude
items.summary: A silent career criminal shot and left for dead by Catalina, who works his way up through Liberty City's underworld to settle the score.

items.name: D-Ice
items.summary: Wichita Gardens gang leader whose phone missions target the Purple Nines.

items.name: Donald Love
items.summary: A reclusive businessman whose real-estate ambitions involve the Cartel and the Colombian drug trade.

items.name: El Burro
items.summary: Puerto Rican gang leader in Hepburn Heights who pays in vehicles and cash for chaos.

items.name: Joey Leone
items.summary: Salvatore's son, based at a Portland garage; assigns car-theft and disposal jobs.

items.name: Kenji Kasen
items.summary: Asuka's brother, based at a Staunton casino; assigns jobs against the Triads and Cartel.

items.name: King Courtney
items.summary: Jamaican gang boss in Staunton who sets Claude up during a later job.

items.name: Luigi Goterelli
items.summary: Runs Luigi's Sex Club 7 and gives Claude his first paying work in Portland.

items.name: Maria Latore
items.summary: Salvatore's unpredictable partner, who attaches herself to Claude after leaving the don.

items.name: Marty Chonks
items.summary: Runs a dog food factory and asks Claude to dispose of people who threaten him.

items.name: Miguel
items.summary: Catalina's partner in the Cartel's SPANK drug operation.

items.name: Phil Cassidy
items.summary: One-armed arms dealer operating out of a Portland warehouse.

items.name: Ray Machowski
items.summary: A dirty cop selling protection and information, eventually forced to flee the city.

items.name: Salvatore Leone
items.summary: Aging head of the Leone family who takes Claude on before suspecting him of betrayal.

items.name: Toni Cipriani
items.summary: Salvatore's trusted enforcer in Portland. Later the protagonist of Liberty City Stories.

items.name: Toni the Tiger
items.summary: A Triad figure involved in the fish factory and Chinatown disputes.

items.name: Introduction
items.summary: Cutscenes depicting Catalina's betrayal of Claude , and the explosion which leaves Portland isolated from the rest of the city and Claude's escape with 8-Ball .

items.name: Carl 'CJ' Johnson
items.summary: Returns to Los Santos after five years away for his mother's funeral and rebuilds the Grove Street Families.

items.name: Catalina
items.summary: CJ's brief girlfriend in the Badlands; robs stores with him in a series of missions.

items.name: Cesar Vialpando
items.summary: Kendl's boyfriend and leader of the Aztecas; CJ's most reliable ally.

items.name: Denise Robinson
items.summary: Grove Street affiliate and one of CJ's girlfriends.

items.name: Eddie Pulaski
items.summary: Tenpenny's brutal partner, killed by CJ in the desert.

items.name: Frank Tenpenny
items.summary: The primary antagonist, a corrupt cop who manipulates every gang in the state.

items.name: Jimmy Hernandez
items.summary: The youngest C.R.A.S.H. officer, torn between loyalty and doing the right thing.

items.name: Jizzy B
items.summary: Pimp whose club fronts the Loco Syndicate's drug operation.

items.name: Ken Rosenberg
items.summary: Vice City lawyer now managing a Las Venturas casino for the mob.

items.name: Kendl Johnson
items.summary: CJ and Sweet's sister, partner of Cesar Vialpando.

items.name: Kent Paul
items.summary: Lewd music-business fixer encountered in San Fierro and Las Venturas.

items.name: Lance 'Ryder' Wilson
items.summary: Hot-headed Grove member who turns on the family.

items.name: Madd Dogg
items.summary: Famous rapper whose career CJ manages after OG Loc steals his work.

items.name: Melvin 'Big Smoke' Harris
items.summary: CJ's childhood friend whose ambition leads him to betray Grove Street.

items.name: Mike Toreno
items.summary: A shadowy federal agent who blackmails CJ into running missions for him.

items.name: Millie Perkins
items.summary: Casino manager CJ dates to obtain the key card for the Caligula's heist.

items.name: OG Loc
items.summary: Aspiring rapper whose career CJ helps launch by stealing Madd Dogg's rhymes.

items.name: Ran Fa Li
items.summary: Senior Triad figure whose protection is a recurring obligation.

items.name: Salvatore Leone
items.summary: Liberty City don who owns Caligula's Palace and is targeted by the Triads.

items.name: Sean 'Sweet' Johnson
items.summary: CJ's older brother and the stubborn leader of Grove Street.

items.name: The Truth
items.summary: A hippie conspiracy theorist who supplies CJ with vehicles and information.
